description: Physical inventory count and quant adjustment — inline count on stock.quant, correcting moves via inventory loss location

core_mechanism.description: Physical inventory count is inline on stock.quant via inventory_mode context flag. No session/order document.
core_mechanism.initiation: action_view_inventory() opens editable list; _set_view_context() sets inventory_mode=True for stock users
core_mechanism.no_action_start_inventory: The _action_start_inventory() method referenced in some research prompts does NOT exist in Odoo 19 Community

stock.quant.description: Core stock record; carries all inventory count fields inline

key_inventory_fields.inventory_quantity: Float('Counted') — user-entered physical count. Editable only in inventory_mode.
key_inventory_fields.inventory_diff_quantity: Float('Difference', computed+stored) = inventory_quantity - quantity when inventory_quantity_set else 0
key_inventory_fields.inventory_quantity_set: Boolean(stored) — True when user has entered a count. Cleared after apply.
key_inventory_fields.is_outdated: Boolean(computed) — True if quantity changed (real move) while inventory_quantity_set=True
key_inventory_fields.inventory_date: Date(computed+stored) — next scheduled count date from cyclic/annual config
key_inventory_fields.last_count_date: Date(computed) — date of last done stock.move.line with is_inventory=True for this quant
key_inventory_fields.cyclic_inventory_frequency: Integer(related from location) — count rotation interval in days
key_inventory_fields.user_id: Many2one res.users — person assigned to count this quant
key_inventory_fields.accounting_date: Date (stock_account only) — override accounting period for JE

key_methods.action_view_inventory: Opens Physical Inventory screen; entry point for count workflow
key_methods.action_set_inventory_quantity: Marks quants for counting; pre-fills inventory_quantity=quantity; warns if already set
key_methods.action_apply_inventory: Checks for outdated quants; if clean calls _apply_inventory(); clears inventory_quantity_set
key_methods.action_apply_all: Batch-apply all flagged quants via stock.inventory.adjustment.name wizard
key_methods.action_set_inventory_quantity_zero: Sets count to zero; in inventory_report_mode applies immediately
key_methods._apply_inventory: Core: creates stock.move per quant (is_inventory=True), calls _action_done(), updates dates
key_methods._get_inventory_move_values: Builds move dict: location pair, qty, lot_id, package_id, is_inventory=True
key_methods._is_inventory_mode: Guard: context.inventory_mode AND user in stock.group_stock_user
key_methods._set_view_context: Sets inventory_mode=True for stock users before opening inventory view

stock.location.description: Location model with inventory loss usage type and cycle count config

usage_inventory.label: Inventory Loss
usage_inventory.help: Virtual location serving as counterpart for physical inventory corrections

cycle_count_fields.last_inventory_date: Date — updated by _apply_inventory() on each apply

product.template.property_stock_inventory: Many2one stock.location (company_dependent, usage='inventory') — per-product override of inventory loss location

res.company.annual_inventory_month: Selection (1-12, default '12') — company-wide annual count month
res.company.annual_inventory_day: Integer (default 31) — day of month for annual count
res.company._create_inventory_loss_location: Creates per-company inventory loss location and sets ir.default for property_stock_inventory

positive_diff.interpretation: Surplus — stock arrives from virtual adjustment location

negative_diff.interpretation: Shrinkage — stock leaves to virtual adjustment location

quant_override._apply_inventory: Groups quants by accounting_date; passes force_period_date for cross-period JE
quant_override._get_inventory_move_values: Adds inventory_name '[Accounted on {date}]' when force_period_date set

move_override._should_create_account_move: True only if: is_storable AND is_valued AND location has valuation_account_id AND qty!=0 AND valuation=real_time
move_override._get_account_move_line_vals: If location_id.valuation_account_id: Dr stock_valuation / Cr location.valuation_account_id. Else: Dr location_dest_id.valuation_account_id / Cr stock_valuation

valuation_overlay.je_condition: inventory loss location must have valuation_account_id set (typically stock adjustment expense account from COA)

cycle_count.mechanism: inventory_date field on quant shows next due date; user filters by overdue in Physical Inventory view

security.group_stock_user: Can enter counts and apply inventory (inventory_mode)
security.group_stock_manager: Can manually delete quants (triggers _apply_inventory with qty=0)

migration_flags: BREAKING: stock.inventory and stock.inventory.line models abolished (Odoo 16+). Full redesign required from Odoo 14.
BREAKING: _action_start_inventory() does NOT exist in Odoo 19. Use action_view_inventory() / inventory_mode context.
BREAKING: inventory_quantity_count field does NOT exist. Use search([('inventory_quantity_set','=',True)]).
INFORMATIONAL: accounting_date on stock.quant is stock_account module only — not present in pure stock install.
INFORMATIONAL: JE for inventory adjustments requires valuation_account_id on the inventory loss location.
INFORMATIONAL: No automatic cron for cycle counts — only date reminders on quant.inventory_date.
NEW_FEATURE: accounting_date per quant allows per-record period override (new vs older Odoo versions).
